textNotes.text: i didnt find any of this shit. there's also a better route directly to the first air anima vent that I did not do in the video. planning on becoming a reactor trackmania player so i can say zoop more often.  zoop zoop zyn

textNotes.author: @Sir_Rebral
textNotes.text:
Great video dude :)

At 8:25 you don't have to go so high, you can go straight from where you are as you crouch through the hole. The video on my channel shows it if you want to see but yeah no need to windstep up higher

at 12:39 the way to not agro them is to just touch the front edge of the circle that gives you charge, you still gain charge on the edge but the enemies wont spawn until you move…

textNotes.author: @zyneater
textNotes.text: There's a skip for that puzzle entirely now.
